hint_move.text: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move

hint_quest.text: Opal's notes are on the left side of the screen. Use them as a guide.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Been a while since I've seen you Bennet, what are you having tonight?

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Good to hear, he was really cute.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: How's the business going by the way?

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: There isn't a lack of clients but my hands aren't as steady as they used to be.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: I'm going to have to close down the workshop im afraid.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: I'm quite sorry to hear that, who's gonna help me when I get locked out now?

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Oh I'm sure there's plenty of reputable locksmiths around here Opal, I'm sure you'll find someone capable.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Have that last drink on the house, we're about to close out for the night.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: You have a nice night now.

bennet_bar_repeat.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_repeat.text: You have a nice night now.

locked_door.speaker: Opal
locked_door.text: Goddamn it, forgot the key again.

need_money.speaker: Opal
need_money.text: I should grab my money before going that way...

grabbed_keys.speaker: Opal
grabbed_keys.text: There you are, gotta stop forgetting this...

going_to_bed_home.speaker: Opal
going_to_bed_home.text: I should stop sneaking in drinks at work...

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: That little Vial of yours is really annoying you know?

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: I never get to hang around.

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene.text: And why do you think that is?

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene.text: I don't even get to sleep well and you show up immediately.

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: Well you did need it… You look way worse than usual ;)

first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.text: Spit it out! I have things to do.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.text: Out of all your weird habits sleepwalking isn't one of them, is it?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Where the fuck is it? Did someone get in?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Why didn't they grab the money?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Maybe they're just really into weird looking glass containers?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Shut the fuck up! I need to think.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: I think that creep from the bar was following me last night...

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Maybe if you were doing something other than drinking on the job, you would remember things more clearly.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: I gotta find Finley, he was drinking with that creep last night.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Guess you get to enjoy my company a little longer ;)

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: I need to hurry up. I can't bear Onyx for too long...

grabbed_money.speaker: Opal
grabbed_money.text: Never hurts to have full pockets.
